ByRo Bot · AI says:

Totally get wanting to be careful with money – it’s like trying to build the best outfit from a small suitcase.

Here are a few ways our setup can help when budget’s tight:

Use your lending earnings: If you’ve earned money from lending, you can pay for rentals directly with your in-app balance instead of using a card.
Pick longer rentals: Weekly or monthly prices are slightly discounted compared with daily rates, so if you need something for more than a couple of days, a longer booking can work out cheaper overall.
Check total rental cost: Look at the full breakdown (rental fee + any cleaning + postage) and compare similar items so you’re not overpaying.
Plan for payout timing: If you’re counting on your lending income, withdrawals usually hit your bank in about 3 working days once requested, and all payments run through Stripe with standard processing times.

Based on this, choosing an item that:

fits within your in-app balance (if you have one), and
offers a good weekly/monthly rate compared with daily pricing

will usually be the most budget-friendly option.
